output.rationale: The requirement pertains to testing and simulating system operation for metal-clad switchgear, as specified in the page header. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the specification. This product is offered as engineered-to-order (ETO), suitable for the detailed requirements of the Syracuse Airport Specification.
